_readme: Hand-maintained metadata for the tables in docs/gdrives.html. Not read by the app.
Drive facts (name, drive_id, style, description, artwork_types) come from
backend/assets/drives.json and backend/assets/artwork_drives.json - do NOT copy them here.
This file only holds what those lists don't know: priority ranking, owner ACK,
owner feedback, and which person owns which drives.
Poster drives are split into drives_mm2k / drives_cl2k. Keys are drive IDs. Fields:
owner    - canonical person name, used to group a maker's drives together
priority - one of: --  -  +  ++  +++   (ascending, DAPS order). Omit = unranked (?)
rank     - position within the tier, following Chris DC's original list. Lower = weaker. 900 = added since
ack      - yes (✅) | unknown or no (❔) | warn (❗) | none (blank)
content  - optional short override for the CONTENT column (default: description from the drive JSON)
feedback - free markdown, shown in the OWNER FEEDBACK column

priority_tiers.label: LOWEST
priority_tiers.content: Collection of others and their posters (Not necessarily conform to our style guidelines)

priority_tiers.label: MEDIUM
priority_tiers.content: Homemade posters (Can easily be exchanged within the same priority)

priority_tiers.label: HIGH
priority_tiers.content: Drazzilb (MM2K holy grail) / High count general CL2K drives

MM2K.feedback: (*) Use this to override/replace posters from one of the drives (or personal/other collections) when you don't want to change priorities for specific reasons.

CL2K.feedback: (*) Use this to override/replace posters from one of the drives (or personal/other collections) when you don't want to change priorities for specific reasons.
